permissions._comment: approved_app_allowlist: friendly name Cortana understands -> the exact command/executable to launch. Only apps listed here can be opened by voice/chat.
permissions._comment2: approved_folder_aliases: friendly name -> absolute Windows path. Replace <you> with your actual username.
permissions._comment3: approved_search_roots: directories search_files() is allowed to scan. Defaults to the folder aliases above if omitted.
